items.exampleEn: Pharmacies keep some medications in special refrigerators.
items.exampleZh: 藥局會把某些藥物放在專用的冰箱裡。

items.exampleEn: The label shows how many doses are in each bottle.
items.exampleZh: 標籤上寫著每瓶有幾劑。

items.exampleEn: Massage has been part of daily life in many cultures for thousands of years.
items.exampleZh: 幾千年來，按摩在許多文化中一直是日常生活的一部分。

items.exampleEn: Early dental tools looked very different from the ones we use today.
items.exampleZh: 早期的牙科工具和我們今天用的很不一樣。

items.exampleEn: Restaurants are checked regularly for kitchen hygiene.
items.exampleZh: 餐廳會定期接受廚房衛生檢查。

items.exampleEn: The singer cleared her throat before the song began.
items.exampleZh: 歌手在歌曲開始前清了清喉嚨。

items.exampleEn: Police can now solve old cases by using DNA.
items.exampleZh: 警方現在能利用 DNA 偵破陳年舊案。

items.exampleEn: A stroke happens when blood cannot reach part of the brain.
items.exampleZh: 血液無法送達腦部某處時，就會發生中風。

items.exampleEn: The chef removed the skin and cut the peach flesh into thin slices.
items.exampleZh: 廚師削掉外皮，把桃子的果肉切成薄片。

items.sentenceEn: Good hand hygiene is one of the simplest ways to stop germs from spreading.
items.sentenceZh: 保持手部衛生，是阻止病菌傳播最簡單的方法之一。

items.audioEn: My dental check-up is at three, so I'll be back in the office around four.
items.audioZh: 我三點要做牙齒檢查，所以大概四點會回到辦公室。
items.questionZh: 說話者大約幾點回辦公室？

items.sentenceEn: Scientists compared the DNA of wolves and pet dogs.
items.sentenceZh: 科學家比較了狼和寵物狗的 DNA。

items.sentenceEn: With every stroke of her brush, the painting came to life.
items.sentenceZh: 她每畫一筆，那幅畫就更加栩栩如生。

items.stemEn: My ____ felt dry after talking on the phone all afternoon.
items.stemZh: 講了一整個下午的電話，我的喉嚨覺得好乾。

items.stemEn: Researchers are testing whether the new ____ works better than older ones.
items.stemZh: 研究人員正在測試這款新藥是否比舊藥更有效。

items.passageEn: Our science class visited a modern research center last week. In the first room, scientists were studying the DNA of plants to grow stronger crops. In another, a team was testing how a new medication behaves inside the body, checking each dose very carefully. Everyone working there followed strict hygiene rules, washing their hands and wearing gloves. Next door, dental students were practicing on models of teeth. Our guide joked that after so much walking, we all needed a massage. Before we left, we watched a short film about how the human throat makes sounds. It was a fascinating day.
items.passageZh: 上週我們的自然課去參觀一間現代化研究中心。在第一個房間，科學家正在研究植物的 DNA，想培育出更強壯的作物。另一間裡，有個團隊正在測試一款新藥在體內如何作用，每一劑都檢查得非常仔細。在那裡工作的每個人都遵守嚴格的衛生規定，會洗手、戴手套。隔壁的牙醫系學生在牙齒模型上練習。導覽員開玩笑說，走了這麼多路，大家都需要按摩一下。離開前，我們看了一部短片，介紹人的喉嚨怎麼發出聲音。那是很有意思的一天。

questions.questionZh: 科學家為什麼研究植物的 DNA？
options: 為了研發新的藥物給病人
為了培育更強壯的作物
為了教牙醫系的學生上課

questions.questionZh: 研究中心的人怎麼遵守衛生規定？

items.promptZh: 她用手指輕輕撫摸小狗的背。
referenceEn: She gently stroked the puppy's back with her fingers.
She stroked the little dog's back softly with her fingers.
rubricZh: stroke 當動詞是「輕撫」（例如 stroke the puppy's back 等）
時態合理即可（例如 stroked、strokes 等）；「輕輕地」可寫，例如 gently、softly 等

items.promptZh: 這種瓜的果肉是橘色的，而且水分很多。
referenceEn: The flesh of this melon is orange and full of water.
This kind of melon has orange flesh that is very juicy.
rubricZh: flesh 指「果肉」，不可數（例如 the flesh of this melon、has orange flesh 等）
「水分很多」可寫，例如 full of water、very juicy 等
